title: Push events from a voice AI agent to the browser
summary: Return a JSON event from a voice AI agent tool and deliver it to the browser connected to the call.
scenario: A booking page that highlights the slot the caller picked, the moment the agent records it

evidence: demo example app.py:409-446 swml_user_event; web/app.js subscribes user_event
demo techtarot app.py:570-588 raw SWML user_event variant
sdk function_result.py:263 swml_user_event wraps user_event in a one-verb SWML action
schema.json UserEvent: event required, any JSON object; commonly used with the browser-sdk
